screening_method: Read all selected labels and distinct takeaways, inspect exact shared IDs/aliases and ranked word/character-neighbor pairs, then compare actual meaning on likely cross-domain mechanisms. Lexical scores are diagnostics, not merge or novelty evidence. Deep per-batch baseline reviews are separately recorded.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: A railway circuit treats specified faults like track occupancy to protect train separation; computer fail-safe defaults deny access unless permission is explicitly granted. The shared fail-safe design principle does not make this concrete railway detection application identical to default authorization.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 004 owns the railway application; 005 owns computer authorization defaults.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Stereographic projection is one specific geometric pole-to-plane construction. Map projection is the wider class of mappings used to flatten Earth and negotiate cartographic distortions.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 004 owns the specific geometric construction; 006 owns the existing general cartographic control.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Mechanical resonance is strong response to forcing near a natural frequency. The 007 Sympathetic resonance proposal concerns vibration transfer between systems with matching harmonics. Both are existing controls and the source-specific coupling discussion is not a second new generic-resonance count.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: The exact 007 registered ID is resolved from its final selection below; no new resonance identity is created.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Allocation concealment prevents recruiters foreseeing the next assignment before enrollment. Blinding withholds treatment knowledge during the study to limit participant and researcher expectations. Timing, actors and the bias pathways differ.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 003 owns allocation concealment; 007 owns generic double-blind study.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Diagnostic metrics condition results on disease status or vice versa. Signal detection models decisions amid noise; an absolute sensory threshold concerns detection probability for stimulus strength. These quantities/frameworks are not interchangeable.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Clinical-test quantities remain in 003; general perceptual measurement in 007.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Pure-tone audiometry is a clinical procedure mapping detection thresholds by sound frequency. Absolute threshold is a general psychophysical property; musical pitch is the perceived high/low ordering of notes.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 003 owns the clinical test; 007 owns the general perception and music senses.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Observing/recording ordinary speech can change the speech researchers seek. Experimenter expectancy concerns researcher-side expectations affecting observation, while social desirability is participant response shaped to appear acceptable. The mechanisms can coexist without being synonyms.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Keep the sociolinguistic observation target explicit; do not rename generic research reactivity as another subject.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Impression management is shaping others’ impressions in ordinary social performances. Social-desirability bias is a measurement distortion in responses given to appear acceptable.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 005 owns the general social-presentation mechanism; 007 owns the specific research-response bias.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: A norm is a shared behavioral expectation. Normative influence is conforming for acceptance; informational influence is treating others as evidence. The expectation and the two compliance/information mechanisms are distinct.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Do not treat the same generic conformity definition as all three cards.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: 005 contains instructional procedures and already registered testing/spacing effects. 007 addresses general memory architecture, interference and motivation. No duplicate retrieval-practice/spacing mechanism remains under a new instructional label.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Keep 005 instructional ownership and preserve existing Testing effect/Spacing effect IDs.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Shortest-path mediation and social tie-formation models differ from graph theory generally, two-class graph structure and a theorem counting spanning trees. These mathematical overlaps do not give another batch ownership of the identical network measure.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 005 remains sole owner of its network measures/models; 004 may link them without duplicating them.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: The earthquake model concerns elastic strain accumulated around a fault and released during slip. Elastic limit is the material boundary beyond which deformation is not wholly recoverable.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 003 owns the geological mechanism; 004 the material-property boundary.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: The depth-dependent ocean current spiral arises from rotation and momentum transfer; Coriolis force is the rotating-frame inertial term more generally.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 003 owns the oceanographic application; 004 the force concept.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Metered outlets and spatially adjusted application are irrigation techniques. Aflaj entries concern gravity-fed systems, shared access/maintenance and a particular protected cultural landscape.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Technique, social-spatial institution and named landscape are separately identifiable subjects; the two 006 Aflaj entries still need their own per-batch review.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: The riparian buffer is a physical vegetated strip with ecological functions. A GIS buffer is a computed distance zone; it need not contain plants or change runoff.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Separate material/ecological and analytical-geospatial meanings.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: The sociolinguistic interview elicits speech with different self-monitoring contexts. The oral-history lead-in records participant/date/location/topic metadata to preserve evidentiary context.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Different interview stages and research functions; no split based only on audience labels.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Mutually accepted conversational knowledge and the process of establishing it differ from the reader presupposed by a text or limits on narrative information.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Conversation pragmatics stays in 005; narrative constructs stay in 006.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Using empty pictorial areas, neighboring-color effects and sequential afterimage effects are specific visual/art subjects. Figure-ground segregation, completion of missing contours and sensory adaptation are general perceptual processes.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 007 alone owns the general figure-ground control; 006’s excluded duplicate remains excluded. Source/card wording must retain the specific art/color mechanisms.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Buddhism is the wider collection of traditions; conventional versus ultimate truth is a particular philosophical distinction with school-specific interpretations.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 006 owns the broad religion control; 007 owns the philosophical distinction.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Glass is a material; Franklin’s rotating-bowl friction instrument is a particular named design using that material.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Do not infer identity from material naming.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Mapping chromosome-marker order from inheritance is distinct from visualizing geographical quantities or reallocating spatial population estimates.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Separate genetic versus geographical meanings.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Wood EMC is a material’s moisture balance with surrounding air under given environmental conditions. Chemical equilibrium concerns reversible reactions; combining equilibrium constants is an algebraic transformation of reaction equations. The wood-specific sorption application is not a new name for reaction equilibrium.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: 003 owns the material/application subject; 004 owns chemical reaction concepts.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Steam bending alters wood pliability with heat and moisture; kerf bending removes material in relief slots. A neutral axis is a stress-distribution feature, and a three-point test measures response in a controlled loading configuration. Manufacturing methods, mechanical property and test remain distinct.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Do not describe the forming methods as merely another elastic stiffness test.

meaning_comparisons.meaning_comparison: Leather temper describes pliability versus firmness of hide. Tempera is a paint-binding technique; the similar label component has no shared learning identity.
meaning_comparisons.boundary: Separate material property from painting medium.
